local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = require(ReplicatedStorage.rbxts_include.RuntimeLib)

-- roblox-ts modules bootstrap their own `_G[script]` entry only when
-- reached through `TS.import`, which TestEZ's plain, tree-walking
-- `require()` never does. Warm every module up through `TS.import` first
-- so TestEZ's own `require()` calls hit Roblox's require() cache instead
-- of an unbootstrapped module. `Monolog` and `MonologTests` are two
-- separately-compiled trees (see "## Tests" in CLAUDE.md), so both need it.
local function warmUp(root)
	for _, inst in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				return TS.import(root, inst)
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("Failed to warm up " .. inst:GetFullName() .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
end

warmUp(ReplicatedStorage.Monolog)
warmUp(ReplicatedStorage.MonologTests)

local TestBootstrap = TS.import(ReplicatedStorage.Monolog, ReplicatedStorage.rbxts_include, "node_modules", "@rbxts", "testez", "src", "TestBootstrap")
local TextReporter = TS.import(ReplicatedStorage.Monolog, ReplicatedStorage.rbxts_include, "node_modules", "@rbxts", "testez", "src", "Reporters", "TextReporter")

local results = TestBootstrap:run({ ReplicatedStorage.MonologTests }, TextReporter)

if results.failureCount > 0 then
	error(("Monolog tests: %d failed, %d passed"):format(results.failureCount, results.successCount))
else
	print(("Monolog tests: all %d passed"):format(results.successCount))
end
